pairs_to_image2d — REPRCONV pairs op

• Data kinds: pairs → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pairs_to_image2d(pairs, shape=(64, 64)) (to call the implementation directly, import reprconv; reprconv.pairs_to_image2d(pairs, shape=(64, 64)); from the registry, opsreprconv.get("pairs_to_image2d"))

Usage

Pairs (N,2) → a scatter-density image (H, W). The third exit from pairs.

Maps column 0 to the row direction and column 1 to the column direction, normalises each by its own min-max and drops them into bins (2-D histogram). It is meant for viewing as a phase plot or correlation plot, and is irreversible (the quantization by the bin width + the normalisation discard the scale of the absolute values). So that the discarded scale can be restored, extent is... not returned -- returning it would make this no longer an image2d. If needed, use x_min etc. of pairs_to_table.

A constant column (min == max) is gathered at position 0.5 (this avoids division by 0, but so that it is not read as "the density is concentrated at the centre", only 1 bin is raised).

Args:

pairs: (N, 2).

shape: (H, W).

Returns:

(H, W) float64, density normalised to a maximum of 1.0.

Raises:

ValueError: bad shape / non-finite / shape exceeds the limit.
